quick-practice-help-v2: Read the question and find the number that belongs in the gap. Sometimes the missing number comes first. From Level 3, type your answer on the number pad. Help gives a clue, then the working, then fills it in. Show choices gives you three numbers. If an answer is not right, you see how it works, and a new question takes its place. There is no clock.
number-hop-help-v2: At the first levels, tap Hop forward one or Hop back one, then choose where you landed. From Level 3, choose your own jumps to reach the flag. Try to get there in the fewest jumps. Help shows a good next jump. Undo takes a jump back, and Start again starts the puzzle over. At the top level, work out where the frog started. There is no clock.
